It inhibits bone resorption and is given intravenously as the sodium salt in the management of osteogenesis imperfecta (p.1083); it has been used in the treatment of malignant hypercalcaemia (p.1083) and diseases associated with excessive bone turnover such as Paget’s disease of bone (p.1086) and osteoporosis (p.1084). ◊ References. 1.
